description: Darken Rahl's death leaves a tear in the veil to the Underworld, allowing the Keeper to send banelings and the dead back into the world. Richard, Kahlan and Zedd are joined by Mord-Sith Cara and search for the Stone of Tears, the only artifact capable of sealing the rift. Along the way Kahlan learns she is the last Confessor, Richard's heritage makes him a target for competing powers, and the Keeper repeatedly tries to corrupt the group before the Stone can be delivered and the veil repaired.

s02e01.description: Rahl's death leaves a tear in the veil to the Underworld, allowing the Keeper's servants to enter the world of the living and making the Stone of Tears the group's new objective. Richard, Kahlan and Zedd begin the search while Cara fights a challenge to her standing among the Mord-Sith and ultimately joins the Seeker's traveling party.

s02e02.description: The search for the Stone leads the group to a D'Haran prison where the dead have returned as banelings who must kill each day to remain alive. Richard tries to stop the killings while learning that a man carrying information needed to locate the Stone has made his own bargain with the Keeper.

s02e03.description: Kahlan learns that Cara was responsible for Dennee's death and wants the Mord-Sith removed from the quest. Cara returns to her home village and is put on trial for crimes committed while serving Rahl, leaving Kahlan to decide whether punishment for Cara's past should end the possibility that Cara can choose differently now.

s02e04.description: Kahlan discovers a teenage girl who appears to be the only other living Confessor and tries to bring her under protection. The girl's untrained power makes every emotional mistake dangerous, forcing Richard and Kahlan to protect her from people seeking to use Confession while teaching her what the ability actually does to another person's will.

s02e05.description: A spell strips Zedd of both his memory and his old age, leaving a younger and more arrogant wizard convinced that Richard should be replaced as Seeker. Richard, Kahlan and Cara have to recover the Zedd they know while his unchecked magic and new ambitions draw him toward a confrontation involving Rahl and another rift to the Underworld.

s02e06.description: Richard helps the pacifist Minders after slave traders attack their community and agrees to teach them how to defend themselves. The Sword of Truth amplifies anger within the group instead of simply giving them discipline, forcing Richard to understand and control the same rage in himself before the training turns the Minders into another threat.

s02e07.description: A D'Haran commander tries to consolidate power after Rahl's death and eliminate anyone who could challenge control of the empire. Richard and Cara trace the struggle to a brothel run by Denna, who plans to use Richard's claim to the throne for her own takeover, while Kahlan and Zedd pursue the commander's forces elsewhere.

s02e08.description: Denna steals the compass needed to locate the Stone of Tears and escapes with Zedd as her prisoner. While pursuing them, Richard is crippled by headaches caused by his emerging wizard powers; the Sisters of the Light tell him that survival requires training at the Palace of the Prophets, forcing him to leave the search for Zedd to Kahlan and Cara.

s02e09.description: At the Palace of the Prophets, Richard trains with the Sisters of the Light and learns from Sister Nicci that their intentions toward him are not what they claim. With Richard unavailable, Zedd accepts that another Seeker must carry the Sword of Truth and joins Kahlan and Cara in finding a replacement, while Richard forms an uneasy alliance with Nicci inside the Palace.

s02e10.description: Richard becomes trapped in the Valley of Perdition, where magic gives physical form to fears involving Kahlan, his mission and the people he loves. Outside the valley, Kahlan, Zedd, Cara and the newly chosen Seeker Leo search for him while Sister Nicci moves against Kahlan and Cara's growing attachment to Leo complicates the rescue.

s02e11.description: An enchanted amulet splits Kahlan into two separate versions of herself: one dominated by the Mother Confessor's duty and power, the other by the emotions she normally restrains. Richard and Cara continue the Stone search while Zedd tries to reunite the two halves before either incomplete Kahlan makes choices the whole person would reject.

s02e12.description: Cara dies protecting Richard and returns as a baneling, bound to the Keeper's rule that she must kill each day to remain alive. Richard, Kahlan and Zedd search for a cure while Cara tries to resist the bargain, and Zedd's brother Thaddicus becomes involved with a potion being sold as a way to end banelings' dependence on murder.

s02e13.description: The Margrave of Rothenberg captures Kahlan as part of a bargain connected to the Keeper, and a spell over his territory prevents the use of magic to free her. Richard, Zedd and Cara exploit the Margrave's search for a bride by entering Cara as a noblewoman, turning courtship rituals into the cover for a rescue operation.

s02e14.description: After failing to kill Kahlan, Sister Nicci is hunted by both the Sisters of the Dark and Darken Rahl. She casts a spell binding her life directly to Kahlan's, making any attack on Nicci fatal to the Mother Confessor and forcing Richard to protect his enemy while leading her toward the Stone of Tears; Kahlan seeks help from her estranged father to break the bond.

s02e15.description: A powerful woman claiming to be the Creator accuses Richard of serving the Keeper and places the Seeker on trial. Kahlan, Cara and Zedd investigate the claimant's identity to expose the deception and save Richard, while Darken Rahl treats her appearance as a threat to his own plans and prepares to eliminate her.

s02e16.description: A magician seeking revenge for sons killed during the war traps Kahlan and Cara inside a sealed tomb and releases a Nygaax as part of his attack on Richard's group. Richard races to free them before the chamber runs out of air, while Zedd faces the creature outside and tries to keep the revenge scheme from claiming more people.

s02e17.description: Zedd and Thaddicus learn that the man responsible for their father's death may still be alive and leave the others to pursue him. Richard's parallel search for information about the Stone brings him to a scholar with knowledge of an ancient scroll, and the two investigations converge on family history that connects Zedd's past to Darken Rahl's.

s02e18.description: A Sister of the Dark steals an ancient scroll containing instructions needed for the Stone quest, sending Richard, Kahlan, Zedd and Cara after her. In the Underworld, Rahl identifies Walter, a man who closely resembles him, and uses the resemblance in a plan to exchange places and return to the living world, drawing the Seeker into the attempted resurrection.

s02e19.description: Newly restored to life, Rahl uses information from the recovered scroll to stay beyond the Keeper's reach and offers Richard knowledge that could advance the Stone search. Richard accepts a temporary alliance with his former enemy, while Kahlan and Cara try to save the last members of a species endangered by Rahl's actions and the Keeper sends the Sisters of the Dark to reclaim him.

s02e20.description: The compass finally leads Richard and Kahlan to a hidden valley whose inhabitants have guarded the Stone of Tears for generations and prevent anyone who enters from leaving. Outside the valley, Cara encounters a woman from her past and she and Zedd are trapped, separating the group just as Richard reaches the object they have spent the season seeking.

s02e21.description: Rahl regains the Stone and turns Cara against Richard, forcing the Seeker to capture his own ally rather than kill her. Zedd attempts to reverse the magic controlling Cara but instead triggers the Spell of Undoing, creating an alternate world in which Cara never became Mord-Sith and the chain of events that once defeated Rahl never occurred.

s02e22.description: Richard reaches the Pillars of Creation with the Stone of Tears and attempts to seal the rifts allowing the Keeper's influence into the world. Separated from his companions, he faces the final struggle over the Stone while Sister Nicci takes control of Kahlan and sends the Mother Confessor against the people trying to stop the Keeper.
